test_cases.question: How many projects does the Starter plan include?
test_cases.ground_truth: Starter includes 3 projects.

test_cases.question: What is the monthly API call allowance on the Team plan?
test_cases.ground_truth: Team includes 2,000,000 API calls per month.

test_cases.question: How much does API overage cost on the Starter plan?
test_cases.ground_truth: 0.40 USD per 1,000 calls above the monthly allowance.

test_cases.question: Is overage ever billed without warning?
test_cases.ground_truth: No. A usage alert is always sent before overage is charged.

test_cases.question: Which two authentication methods does Orbit support?
test_cases.ground_truth: Project API keys and OAuth 2.0 device flow.

test_cases.question: How long do OAuth access tokens last?
test_cases.ground_truth: OAuth access tokens expire after 60 minutes.

test_cases.question: When do refresh tokens expire?
test_cases.ground_truth: Refresh tokens expire after 30 days of inactivity.

test_cases.question: Do project API keys expire on their own?
test_cases.ground_truth: No. Project API keys never expire automatically and must be rotated manually.

test_cases.question: What prefix identifies a production API key?
test_cases.ground_truth: Production keys use the orb_live_ prefix.

test_cases.question: Can a test key read production data?
test_cases.ground_truth: No. Test keys cannot read production data.

test_cases.question: What is the default rate limit on the Team plan?
test_cases.ground_truth: 600 requests per minute per project.

test_cases.question: How long can a burst exceed the rate limit?
test_cases.ground_truth: Bursts of up to twice the limit are permitted for 10 seconds.

test_cases.question: What does the API return when the rate limit is exceeded?
test_cases.ground_truth: HTTP 429 with a Retry-After header expressed in seconds.

test_cases.question: Will creating more API keys increase my throughput?
test_cases.ground_truth: No. Rate limits are enforced per project, not per API key.

test_cases.question: How long are event logs retained on Starter?
test_cases.ground_truth: Event logs are retained for 30 days on Starter.

test_cases.question: Can a deleted project be restored?
test_cases.ground_truth: Yes, within a 14-day soft-delete window, by an account owner.

test_cases.question: How often are backups taken?
test_cases.ground_truth: Backups are taken every 6 hours and stored in a separate region.

test_cases.question: Which plans support point-in-time restore?
test_cases.ground_truth: Team and Enterprise only, with 5-minute granularity.

test_cases.question: Can a project change region after it is created?
test_cases.ground_truth: No. The region is fixed at creation; migrating requires export and re-import into a new project.

test_cases.question: Which regions does Orbit run in?
test_cases.ground_truth: us-east, eu-west, ap-south and ap-southeast.

test_cases.question: Where are backups of EU projects stored?
test_cases.ground_truth: Inside eu-west, because EU projects keep all customer data including backups in region.

test_cases.question: How many times does a failed webhook delivery retry?
test_cases.ground_truth: 5 times, with exponential backoff over roughly one hour.

test_cases.question: What counts as a failed webhook delivery?
test_cases.ground_truth: The endpoint not returning a 2xx status within 10 seconds.

test_cases.question: What happens after five webhook failures?
test_cases.ground_truth: The webhook is marked suspended and must be re-enabled manually.

test_cases.question: How are webhook payloads signed?
test_cases.ground_truth: With HMAC-SHA256 using the webhook secret, in the Orbit-Signature header.

test_cases.question: What is the first-response target for Team support?
test_cases.ground_truth: 1 business day.

test_cases.question: What uptime does the Enterprise SLA guarantee?
test_cases.ground_truth: 99.9% uptime.

test_cases.question: How large can SLA credits be and when must they be claimed?
test_cases.ground_truth: Credits are capped at 30% of the monthly invoice and must be claimed within 30 days of the incident.

test_cases.question: Does the Starter plan include email support?
test_cases.ground_truth: No. Starter includes community support only.

test_cases.question: What is Orbit's discount for annual prepayment?
test_cases.ground_truth: The handbook does not state any annual prepayment discount.

test_cases.question: How many regions support point-in-time restore on the Starter plan?
test_cases.ground_truth: None — point-in-time restore is not available on Starter.

test_cases.question: What is the SLA response target for severity-1 incidents?
test_cases.ground_truth: 4 hours, on Enterprise.
